content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to transmit data from [product_name] using Modbus?
This is a recurring topic; previous threads discussed [product_name] and Modbus issues.
The [version_no] version provides communication via Profinet. Could that be useful in your case?
Hi, Just to clarify, the [version_no] version offers Ethernet communication, not Profinet.
I see—I made a mistake earlier. Thank you for correcting me.
Hello! You might use the Weintek 8070ih as a gateway. Weintek supports S7-200 and has Modbus TCP/RTU connections. I tried this setup and it works. [user_name].
A new question by [user_name] has been posted in a separate thread with the subject 'Is it Possible to Use Modbus with [product_name] 8?'. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are uncertain about the direct Modbus compatibility of [product_name], leading to confusion about supported protocols. Some users mistakenly associate certain product versions with communication options they may not have, such as Profinet. Recommendations include considering third-party gateways for Modbus integration. Overall, the core concern is ambiguous Modbus support and protocol options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that [product_name] will either support Modbus directly or easily facilitate integration with Modbus-equipped systems. Clear guidance on available protocols and straightforward compatibility is sought.
